comments: Child corrects their own color identification (green to red) in a discussion about the television.
Child denies the truth of the proposition that the object belongs to the father, correcting the attribution in response to the caregiver's question.
Child refuses mother's offer to fix the watch ('bōʔi nesadēr laḳ' in line 9354).
Child states that nothing is written in the picture in response to 'ma katuv batmuna?'; indicates absence of text.
Child asserts that the object is not a cube; a factual claim about identity.
Child asserts the absence of the spilled liquid on the ear, confirmed by MOT's mention that it dried up (hityabēš).
Child denies a proposition (likely about ownership of the ball) and asserts 'this is mine', which the INV confirms in line 32792.
Child asks if the device doesn't tickle them; a factual query about a state is Denial.
Child questions the identity of the object after Mother calls it an album; it is a claim about a fact.
Child uses negative imperative to prevent someone from taking the object the mother wants her to give away.
Child denies that the other person took the object; SEF's response 'I made a mistake' confirms a factual dispute.
Child uses negative imperative to prevent someone from taking her horse.
Child responds to 'what do you want?' with 'no, let me see', rejecting the current restriction/state to request access.
Child asserts that the candle/fire is finished/gone; fits Nonexistence.
Child denies the mother's assertion in line 110082 that Miryam can do what she wants.
Child refuses the proposal to tell more to the tape (line 110728), preferring to wait for mother.
Child refuses the mother's proposal to tell a story on the recorder (line 110821).
Child disagrees with mother's claims about the TV and parents' problems (lines 115242-115245).
Child rejects the rabbit cake mentioned in the album (line 116070), expressing a refusal of the item.
Child expresses a preference/dislike for rabbits after MOT mentions rabbit music; no offer is being refused.
Child refuses mother's attempt to take the object or put it in the container (line 116335).
Child refuses mother's directive to put the item in the trash (line 117070).
Child denies the mother's characterization of her as a naughty girl following the question 'ken Hagār ?'.
Child states she doesn't want the item after Father forbids it (lines 117184-117193); it is a claim about her state rather than a refusal of an offer or directive.
Child refuses the caregiver's proposal to go to sleep (line 129053).
Child denies the truth of the question about going to kindergarten (line 129110); repeats previous turn's negation.
Child asserts that the mother is not helping; mother's response 'loʔ' (line 173162) treats this as a factual claim.
Child rejects the mother's proposal to tell a story about 'the Mess of Ariq' (line 194985).
Child is narrating a story; the negation is a factual claim that the pacifier was not found.
The phrase 'Bli Sodot' is a title/name, as confirmed by the mother's follow-up question 'ma hayā ba# Bli Sodōt ?' (What happened in 'Bli Sodot'?). It is not functioning as a negation act.
Child answers the question 'Where?' (line 196038) by stating they do not know; this is a factual claim about their knowledge.
Child refuses the book offered by the interviewer in line 229700.
Negative imperative telling the father to stop saying a specific word ('mexashefa').
Child makes a factual claim that something was not taken from this location; no offer or directive is being refused.
Child contests the adult's claim that both objects are discs (line 271667) by asserting one is not a disc.
Child states there is nothing today ('eyn klum'), describing the absence of entities.
Child denies that the object is an album, later clarifying it is a book (line 272417).
Child says 'this is not' (ze loʔ) while identifying objects in a picture; denies the identity of the object.
Child asserts their own success in opening the object, denying the previous inability or need for help.
Child is playing doctor and asserts that the action does not hurt; mother's echo confirms this as a factual claim.
The token 'af' here refers to the noun 'nose' (describing an elephant's long nose), not a negation.
Child corrects the color of the balloon ('this is not blue, yellow') after the mother's correction in line 285012.
